file_reasoning: CallCenter phone-order draft, cart and payment footer.

resource_binding_reasoning.reasoning: Header/cart/payment regions use CanEditOperation as hit-test flag rather than IsEnabled; keyboard focus may still interact, so command/model gates remain necessary. Phone field immediately updates and lookup is asynchronous UI007 context.
Summary wraps3lines, check/warning icons use actual details flag, user can open full address editor. No independent text describes icon state, but summary may convey fields.
Named empty/cart scroll visibility controlled in codebehind, not static binding. External Cart event unsubscribe risk UI015 belongs codebehind.
Nested root binds row operations correctly; delete and plus/minus have explicit accessible Arabic names. Quantity30px may be narrow for large numbers.
Flyout has two-way Notes and chip Click with44px menu opener. Popup DataContext inheritance and current line targeting require native test. Text is a real draft and no physical print sent here.

Wallet textbox lacks CanEditOperation disabling even where payment segments hit-test gated; immutable pending DTO protects retry but editable draft can diverge visually. VM server validation authoritative.

Submit uses IsShiftOpen enablement and command; no busy caption in markup. Clear explicitly uses CanEditOperation. Footer includes subtotal and total delivery but no tax/breakdown or estimated qualifier; authoritative amount returned by server.

tests_and_limits: NOT_EXECUTED. Verify keyboard edits during unresolved operation, wallet fields, many lines/scaled footer, note flyout binding, exact retry and totals after server repricing. No callable symbols in XAML.
recommendations: Prefer actual enabled states plus model guards and explicit busy/retry feedback. Keep command immutability and process recovery tests distinct from pointer disable.
